listing_title: Trilocale di Nuova Costruzione Vista Mare a Caorle — JBC Immobiliare
raw_text: IT EN DE MENU HOME / NEW DEVELOPMENTS / TRILOCALE DI NUOVA COSTRUZIONE VISTA MARE A CAORLE NEW DEVELOPMENT · APARTMENT Trilocale di Nuova Costruzione Vista Mare a Caorle PORTO SANTA MARGHERITA · CAORLE · VENEZIA PRICE €336,000 Photos (14) Floor plans (1) 1 / 14 FLOOR AREA 86 m² BEDROOMS 2 BATHROOMS 1 LIFT No ENERGY CLASS A4 Overview Welcome to your new home in Caorle! A walk under the sun, the refreshing greenery of gardens, and a beautiful swimming pool await you upon your return. In Lido Altanea, a stunning setting within the municipality of Caorle, a new concept of seaside living comes to life. This modern residence, nestled in a quiet and reserved area just 200 meters from the sea, is designed for those seeking the perfect balance between comfort, nature, and relaxation. The project is currently at an advanced raw state with delivery expected by the end of 2027. It offers elegant newly built three-room apartments intended for those who desire a modern, efficient, and comfortable seaside home. This apartment, located on the second floor, stands out for its extraordinary brightness, complete privacy, and pleasant sea view. The heart of the home is the spacious living area with kitchenette that seamlessly connects to the outside through a large livable terrace: truly an outdoor lounge ideal for sunny breakfasts, sunset aperitifs or relaxing summer evenings caressed by marine breezes. The sleeping area is designed to ensure privacy and restorative rest for the whole family. You will find two well-proportioned and comfortable bedrooms: one spacious double bedroom serving as your main retreat; and another twin room perfect for children or guests or can be used as versatile space depending on your needs. Completing this apartment is a modern bathroom that is functional yet meticulously finished. Each unit is designed for maximum energy savings while respecting environmental standards. The apartment will feature photovoltaic systems along with innovative technologies ensuring thermal comfort acoustics complemented by high-quality finishes. An exclusive covered parking space completes this property. To make this three-room apartment truly yours we collaborate with specialists in interior furnishings who will guide you step-by-step in selecting tailored solutions & furniture options. The construction site can already be visited by appointment: it’s a unique opportunity to see firsthand what’s being developed & start imagining your next vacations here!
